name: cell division cycle 73
pathways: transcription elongation by RNA polymerase II
negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: CDC73 encodes parafibromin. Annotated molecular activities include RNA polymerase II complex binding. It participates in transcription elongation by RNA polymerase II and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to hyperparathyroidism 2 with jaw tumors (autosomal dominant); parathyroid gland carcinoma (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Parathyroid carcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
Autosomal dominant; strong GenCC assertion from Ambry Genetics. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports copy-number alteration context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.
